description: List Vietnam's provinces and centrally-run cities. scope "new" (default): the 34 provinces in force since 1 July 2025, each with its code, number of communes and the old provinces merged into it. scope "old": the 63 provinces before the reform, each with the new province it became part of. Use for overviews or to answer "which provinces were merged into X". Example: {"scope":"old"}.

scope.description: "new" (default): 34 provinces after 1 July 2025, with the old provinces merged into each. "old": 63 provinces before the reform, with the new province each went into.
